Class ShopSettingEvent<T>

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent
com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.PhasedEvent
com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.settings.ShopSettingEvent<T>
Type Parameters:
T - Represents the type of the setting that this event is for.
All Implemented Interfaces:
QSCancellable, org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ShopBenefitAddEvent, ShopBenefitEvent, ShopBenefitRemoveEvent, ShopCurrencyEvent, ShopDisplayEvent, ShopItemEvent, ShopNameEvent, ShopOwnerEvent, ShopOwnerNameEvent, ShopPlayerGroupEvent, ShopPriceEvent, ShopSignLinesEvent, ShopStateEvent, ShopTaxAccountEvent, ShopTypeEnhancedEvent, ShopUnlimitedEvent
public class ShopSettingEvent<T> extends PhasedEvent
ShopSettingEvent - Represents an event that is tied to a shop setting.

This is a phased event, which has a lifecycle. The Pre, Main, and Post phases of the lifecycle relate to a change happening in the setting. The retrieve phase indicates that it's simple a call to retrieve the setting.
